newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain to receive 115-130 bln pta for TISA - agency.
newsitem.headline: Spain to receive 115-130 bln pta for TISA - agency.

text.p: Spain's Economy under-secretary Fernando Diaz Moreno said on Monday the government expects to receive between 115 and 130 billion pesetas from the sale of its 23.7 percent stake of Telefonica Internacional (TISA).

The sale will be via an auction with a restricted number of participants and will take place four to six months from now, Moreno told reporters after an economic seminar in Madrid, according to Europa press news agency.
Moreno added that Spanish giant Telefonica --which has the remaining 76.3 percent in TISA-- is seen as the natural buyer for the state's stake.
TISA had 1996 turnover of 354 billion pesetas, up 19 percent from 1995.
